about: Shared cases for agentic/cypherfix_triage/evidence.py redact_secret_shapes and its
TypeScript port webapp/src/lib/plugins/redact.ts (TD-25, R-32). Synthetic values only;
`expected` was produced once by the Python function in the agent image and reviewed by eye.
Both test files assert every case: change the Python, regenerate, and the port must follow.

vectors.name: plain text is unchanged
vectors.input: GET https://example.com/login from 192.0.2.10 returned 200 for user bob
vectors.expected: GET https://example.com/login from 192.0.2.10 returned 200 for user bob

WWW-Authenticate: Basic realm="example.com"

vectors.name: a word character before AKIA (Unicode word boundary)
a combining mark before AKIA is not a word character
superscript digit after the key keeps it inside a word
dotted capital I matches i case-insensitively
byte order mark is not whitespace
carriage return inside a header line
line separator does not end a header line
astral characters are counted as one
a long tool output with several secrets
